hypothesis.title: Cross-Border Return Transmission from the US Session to European and Japanese Equity Markets
hypothesis.statement: The previous US session predicts the next European and Japanese session returns.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: beta = 0 for US(t-1) -> JP(t) and US(t-1) -> EU(t).
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: beta > 0 for both targets (Bonferroni alpha 0.025 and placebo p < 0.05).
hypothesis.methodology: HAC lead-lag OLS, circular-shift placebo, Cholesky FEVD spillover index
hypothesis.summary_findings: Nikkei beta=0.500 (t=7.70); Euro Stoxx beta=0.118 (t=1.93); FEVD spillover 22.4%.
